description: Expander for Looper, placed immediately to the right of it, which opens the loop's feedback path so that what is written back can be sent through effects first

params.text: Scales how much of the returning signal is written back into the loop on each pass: 100% keeps the old layer whole, and lower settings fade it away over repeats

inputs.text: Sets the feedback from nothing at 0V to the full amount at 10V, with the F.BACK knob attenuating it
The left signal written back into the loop in place of what SEND carried; with nothing patched the loop writes its own audio back
The right signal written back into the loop in place of what SEND carried; with nothing patched the loop writes its own audio back

outputs.text: The left side of the loop as it is read out, before anything is written back, for feeding an effect
The right side of the loop as it is read out, before anything is written back, for feeding an effect

notes: the module is read only while a Looper is touching its left-hand side and neither module is bypassed; on its own it does nothing and its send jacks carry nothing
the feedback amount applies only while Looper is recording, playing or overdubbing; while Looper is stopped the whole loop is written back whatever the knob reads
the lamp at the top is lit while a Looper is touching the left-hand side of this module and is not bypassed
